messages:
priya: Quick sync — packaging launch plan for pricing page experiments. Main asks: update FAQ entries for tier differences, finalize tier names, QA calculator copy/UX, and inbound lead routing for webinar signups. Can we land decisions by EOD Thu?

marco: +1 on deadline. I'll own tier-name shortlist. thinking 3 options: 'Starter / Pro / Enterprise', 'Developer / Business / Platform', or 'Core / Scale / Enterprise'. Will post picks in 30m.

evelyn: I can own FAQ edits. Will draft bullets today. Need latest answers from product on Dedicated vs Hosted differences. @dmitri can you confirm bullet points?

dmitri: Reuse: "Dedicated = reserved GPU capacity with SLA; Hosted = flexible, pay-as-you-go." Also add a line on Private: "VPC/on-prem with KMS". I'll paste exact two-line blurbs in channel.

noah: UX note — the calculator should show monthly vs committed savings toggle. Also add a 'recommended' hint for startup devs.

june: Design will produce 2 calculator UI variants (compact vs expanded). I need the copy and the calculation specs. Can someone share expected inputs (tokens/month, avg seq len, embeddings count)?

priya: I'll pull sample telemetry and share ranges. Quick ask for inbound routing: webinar signups should map to CS queue A if MRR > $5k, otherwise to nurture flow. CS-bot should we create a webhook mapping?

cs-bot: webhook created: /hooks/pricing-webinar. Route rules: {"mrr_threshold":5000,"high_value_queue":"CS-A","nurture_list":"webinar-nurture"} 

marco: Back on tier names: uploading shortlist in 10. Leaning away from 'Metered' since it's confusing externally.

evelyn: FAQ draft plan: top Qs — 'Which tier is best for latency-sensitive apps?', 'How does billing work for embeddings?', 'Can I pin model versions?'. I'll drop first pass by 3pm.

dmitri: Suggest a tiny technical FAQ addendum: snippet on quantization/accuracy tradeoffs for Dedicated vs Hosted. One sentence each.

noah: For benchmark narrative — we should show cost-per-1k-tokens for a common seq length (512) across the tiers and one real customer case study. I'll write the blurb and ask analytics for numbers.

june: Design question — can we show a small badge on Pricing page 'Best for startups' tied to the calculator recommendation? Needs product sign-off.

priya: Product sign-off: approved for 'recommended' tag for usage <= 1M tokens/month.

marco: Posted tier-name options: 1) Core / Scale / Enterprise  2) Launch / Growth / Dedicated  3) Starter / Pro / Enterprise. Pick your fave with :one: :two: :three: reactions.

(30m)

marco: Reactions show top is option 1. I'll lock that in unless objections by EOD.

evelyn: No objections. Option 1 works with FAQ tone.

priya: Next steps: evelyn will send FAQ first pass; june will upload two UI mocks by tomorrow; noah will post benchmark numbers when available; marco locks tier names; cs-bot will deploy webhook rule to staging.

june: Will need copy for tooltip microcopy. Leaving a small list of 6 microcopy slots in Figma.

dmitri: I'll prepare the 2-line technical addendum and a 1-paragraph note for the webinar landing page (how Redwood inference compares performance-wise).

noah: Can we also add a small A/B test for CTA: 'Estimate my bill' vs 'See recommended plan'? We'll wire experiments in GA.

priya: Good idea. Let's add experiment in launch checklist. Final ask — please add any launch post copy suggestions here; planning to draft the benchmark narrative and webinar invite tomorrow. Thanks all. :rocket:
